newsitem.title: USA: SPR Inc IPO postponed due to market.
newsitem.headline: SPR Inc IPO postponed due to market.

text.p: SPR Inc postponed its planned initial public offering on Tuesday due to market conditions, lead underwriter Smith Barney said.
The IPO had been tentatively slated to price on Monday for trading Tuesday.
Prior to the postponement, SPR reduced the terms for its initial public offering for a second time, cutting the number of shares to 2.2 million and lowering the estimated price to $12 each.

The information technology services first filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of 2.7 million shares at $14 to $16 each. Last month, it cut the estimated price to $13 to $15.
